span.t: Step 1: Use the "+ Add Leave Type" button to register new leave type classifications.
Step 2: Drag and drop rows using the ⠿ handle to reorder leave types in priority sequence.
Step 3: Click any leave type name or the eye icon to view details, governing policies, and employee allocations.
Step 4: Use the Admin/Employee toggle switch in the header to preview employee view.

ul.li: Category: Paid, Unpaid, or Partially Paid leave.
Eligibility Scope: Restrict leave availability by Department, Unit, Grade Level, or Named Employees.
Accrual Policy: Choose upfront allocation at year start, monthly accruals, or hire anniversary renewal.
Safeguards: Configure max consecutive days and team overlap limits to prevent operational under-staffing.

div.strong: Q: What happens when a leave type is deactivated?
div.span: Existing allocations remain intact, but employees can no longer submit new leave requests for that category.

div.strong: Q: How is team overlap calculated?
div.span: The percentage of active department employees away on overlapping dates is calculated automatically upon request submission.
